intro.text: A seon: a floating sphere of light who works with the Ghostblood agent Codenames.

items.text: Dao serves with Codenames in a Ghostblood team working against the Set. His main job is passing messages quickly between its members.

When Moonlight brought Marasi to the Ghostblood safehouse, Dao greeted her in a language she didn't know; according to Codenames, he had praised her hair. Marasi, to whom his name sounded like "Dae-oh", found him baffling. He linked to another seon so the team could speak with Kelsier, then left with Codenames to send word to Ghostbloods across the Basin.

appearance.text: A glowing sphere of shimmering white light about the size of a melon, with a faint symbol at its center. He floats, and can link to other seons to talk at once across great distances. He speaks in a soft male voice, but apparently not in the northern Scadrians' language.
